name: Association of Private Hospital and Nursing Home
secondaryTagline: Together for Better Healthcare in West Bengal
registeredOffice: BD 116, Flat 301, 3rd Floor, AAI, Newtown, Kolkata – 700156 (P.S. Newtown, Dist. 24 Parganas (North))
registration: Registered as a society (Societies Registration Act)
scope: West Bengal — state-level body with district/area units
mission: To strengthen and support private hospitals and nursing homes by promoting quality healthcare, ethical practices, collaboration, and constructive engagement with the Government for the benefit of patients and society.
vision: To build a united, trusted, and progressive network of private healthcare providers committed to accessible, affordable, and high-quality healthcare across the State.
objectives: Promote ethical, transparent, patient-centric healthcare practices among private hospitals and nursing homes
Safeguard the interests of member institutions while upholding professionalism and integrity
Work collaboratively with Government and regulatory authorities to improve healthcare policy and implementation
Encourage continuous quality improvement, patient safety, and regulatory compliance
Provide a platform for knowledge sharing, training, and capacity building
Foster unity, cooperation, and mutual support among private healthcare providers
Improve access to affordable, quality healthcare through innovation and collaboration
Represent the collective voice of private hospitals and nursing homes on sectoral issues and public health initiatives

membershipCategories.name: General Member
membershipCategories.description: Proprietor/partner/director of a Clinical Establishment with a valid (or ≤6-month-lapsed) CE licence. Holds voting rights. Cannot simultaneously belong to a similar association.

membershipCategories.name: Associate Member
membershipCategories.description: Partner/director/first-degree family of a CE owner. No voting rights. Fees are set at 50% of a General Member.

membershipCategories.name: Honorary Member
membershipCategories.description: Patrons/advisors/eminent individuals. Exempt from fees. No voting rights unless specifically granted.

membershipCategories.name: Special Membership
membershipCategories.description: Core Committee discretion for applicants who don't meet standard criteria, subject to Governing Body approval.

additionalFeeNotes: Founder Members: One-time ₹10,000 contribution to the initial corpus (standard annual fee applies thereafter).
Revenue Sharing: 60% retained by District Committee, 40% to State Committee.
